findings.description: Olaya Guerrero married Baltasar Guerrero, son of Gregorio Guerrero and Maria Ygnacia Garrido, on 13 October 1768 at Higüey, La Altagracia, Dominican Republic; the entry indexes the bride as Olaya Vrtarte (Urtarte).
supporting_sources: Dominican Republic, Marriages, 1743-1929 — marriage entry for Baltasar Guerrero and Olaya Vrtarte, 13 Oct 1768

findings.description: Olaya Guerrero's parents were Gregorio Vrtarte (Urtarte) and Baltasara de Reyna, per the same marriage entry.

target_person.name: Gregorio Vrtarte and Baltasara de Reyna

supporting_sources: Dominican Republic, Marriages, 1743-1929 — marriage entry for Baltasar Guerrero and Olaya Vrtarte, 13 Oct 1768, naming her parents Gregorio Vrtarte and Baltasara de Reyna
